<?php
$value = 7;
$alias =& $value;
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($alias);
$value = 17;
echo $wrapper->getValue(), "|", $alias, "|";
try { $wrapper->__construct(23); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
echo $wrapper->getValue();

<?php
class DirectSensitiveLeaf24 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
$leaf = new DirectSensitiveLeaf24();
$weak = \WeakReference::create($leaf);
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($leaf);
unset($leaf);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";
$copy = $wrapper->getValue();
unset($wrapper);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";
unset($copy);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "N|" : "L|";

<?php
function direct_arg24($value) { echo "A", $value, "|"; return $value; }
try { new \SensitiveParameterValue(); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { new \SensitiveParameterValue(direct_arg24(7), direct_arg24(9)); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue(17);
try { $wrapper->__construct(); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { $wrapper->__construct(direct_arg24(23), direct_arg24(29)); }
catch (\ArgumentCountError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
echo $wrapper->getValue();

<?php
function direct_named24($value) { echo "A", $value, "|"; return $value; }
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue(...["value" => 7]);
echo $wrapper->getValue(), "|";
try { new \SensitiveParameterValue(9, ...["value" => 11]); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
try { new \SensitiveParameterValue(Value: direct_named24(13), value: direct_named24(17)); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
echo "END";

<?php
namespace DirectScope24;
use SensitiveParameterValue as Snapshot24;
$first = new Snapshot24(value: 7);
$class = "SensitiveParameterValue";
$second = new $class(value: 9);
$method = "__CoNsTrUcT";
try { $second->$method(17); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
echo $first->getValue(), "|", $second->getValue();

<?php
class DirectReentryLeaf24 {
    public function __construct(public string $label) {}
    public function __destruct() { echo $this->label, "|"; }
}
$old = new DirectReentryLeaf24("O");
$weak = \WeakReference::create($old);
$wrapper = new \SensitiveParameterValue($old);
unset($old);
try { $wrapper->__construct(new DirectReentryLeaf24("N")); }
catch (\Error $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), "|"; }
unset($error);
$stored = $wrapper->getValue();
echo $stored->label, "|";
unset($stored, $wrapper);
echo $weak->get() === null ? "NULL" : "LIVE";
